verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a general import feature and a Markdown/Obsidian import path that creates a separate object for each Markdown file, so plain-Markdown switchers are covered at a basic level. The evidence never mentions Notion, Evernote, or Roam importers, nor whether links, folder structure, or attachments survive. Missing for 10: documented Notion/Evernote/Roam importers, evidence that internal links and attachments are preserved, evidence that hierarchy is preserved beyond one object per file, independent or hands-on import reports.
